name: Button Mash
description: Kid-safe curated subset of the games directory: games that pass the Kids-mode audit (no open chat, no unmoderated multiplayer chat or user content, no gambling, no graphic/horror content). Each record carries kid_safe, no_chat, age_band (5-7/8-10/11-12), parent_note, verify_live, and audit_basis. Assessments are snapshots, not guarantees.

kid-safe.description: Slide numbered tiles and merge them to reach 2048. Deceptively simple, endlessly restartable.
kid-safe.parent_note: Just numbers and merging — no chat, no accounts, no ads on the site. A great warm-up brain game.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player page; play2048.co has no accounts, chat, or user-generated content.

kid-safe.title: Wordle
kid-safe.description: One five-letter word a day, six guesses. The whole internet solves the same puzzle.
kid-safe.parent_note: One word a day, no chat or accounts. Good for spelling — younger kids may need a grown-up for tricky words.
kid-safe.audit_basis: NYT daily word puzzle; single-player, no chat, no user content; vocabulary can challenge under-8s.

kid-safe.title: Connections
kid-safe.description: Sort sixteen words into four secret groups. Much harder than it looks.
kid-safe.parent_note: Word-grouping puzzle, no chat. The words are clean but the puzzles are genuinely hard — the watch is frustration, not content.
kid-safe.audit_basis: NYT daily puzzle; single-player, no chat, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Little Alchemy 2
kid-safe.description: Combine earth, fire, air and water to discover 700+ items. Digital tinkering at its finest.
kid-safe.parent_note: Combine air + water = rain-style discovery. No chat, no accounts, friendly visuals. Some combos need reading.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player sandbox; no accounts, chat, or user content.

kid-safe.title: The Password Game
kid-safe.description: A password field with increasingly unhinged rules. You will lose. You will laugh.
kid-safe.parent_note: A silly rules-based puzzle on neal.fun. No chat. Reading-heavy and genuinely hard — best for older kids.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player; no accounts, chat, or user content.

kid-safe.title: Draw Logos From Memory
kid-safe.description: Redraw famous logos from memory and get mercilessly judged. Deeply humbling.
kid-safe.parent_note: Draw brand logos from memory. No chat. Watch: it is brand-heavy by design — fine as a drawing warm-up.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player drawing game; no chat, no accounts, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Globle
kid-safe.description: Guess the mystery country from hot/cold distance hints. Geography Wordle.
kid-safe.parent_note: Guess-the-country guessing game. No chat, no accounts. Great geography practice.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player daily geography game; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: Worldle
kid-safe.description: Name the country from its silhouette alone. One a day.
kid-safe.parent_note: Guess the country from its shape. No chat, no accounts. Classroom-friendly.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player daily geography game; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: Framed
kid-safe.description: Guess the movie from a single frame. Six frames, one answer.
kid-safe.parent_note: Guess the movie from stills. No chat. Some stills are from teen or adult films — the game itself is tame, but watch for movie picks you have not heard of.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player daily game; no chat, no user content; movie stills can come from any film.

kid-safe.title: Sudoku
kid-safe.description: Fast, clean browser Sudoku with note mode. Zero friction, all logic.
kid-safe.parent_note: Classic number puzzle on itch.io. No chat, no accounts. Pick easy grids for younger players.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player browser puzzle; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: Type Help
kid-safe.description: A long-form computer-file mystery in the spirit of Her Story and Obra Dinn.
kid-safe.parent_note: Typing helper game. No chat was found on the page. If it ever asks for anything odd, close it.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Assessment from page inspection only — not played end-to-end; flagged verify_live.

kid-safe.title: Asteroid Launcher
kid-safe.description: Drop asteroids on any city and watch the physics play out. Science, but fun.
kid-safe.parent_note: Launch asteroids at a city on neal.fun — a cartoon sandbox toy. No chat, no accounts.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player toy on neal.fun; no chat, accounts, or user content.

kid-safe.title: Seterra
kid-safe.description: Geography quizzes with 400+ map challenges. You'll learn every capital by accident.
kid-safe.parent_note: Geography quizzes, no chat. Clean and classroom-friendly.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Quiz site; single-player modes have no chat or user content.

kid-safe.title: 0hh1
kid-safe.description: A tiny perfect logic puzzle: fill the grid red or blue, no three in a row. Fresh puzzles every day.
kid-safe.parent_note: Tiny logic puzzle, no chat, no accounts.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player logic puzzle; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: Koalas to the Max
kid-safe.description: Split a photo into smaller and smaller circles to reveal what's underneath. Weirdly, deeply addictive.
kid-safe.parent_note: Click to split circles into koalas — a pure toy with no chat and no content at all.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player visual toy; no interaction surface of any kind.

kid-safe.title: Space Elevator
kid-safe.description: Ride a space elevator from Earth to orbit, learning real orbital physics as you climb.
kid-safe.parent_note: Build a space elevator on neal.fun. A gentle sim toy, no chat.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player toy on neal.fun; no chat, accounts, or user content.

kid-safe.title: Quick, Draw!
kid-safe.description: Doodle against a neural net that guesses your drawing in 20 seconds. Humbling for actual artists.
kid-safe.parent_note: Google draws with you: sketch, and it guesses what it is. No chat with people — but drawings are sent to Google's public dataset, so never draw names or personal info.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Solo drawing game; no chat. Google's own page notes drawings may be used for research/dataset.

kid-safe.title: QWOP
kid-safe.description: Run 100 meters with four keys controlling individual leg muscles. A masterpiece of suffering.
kid-safe.parent_note: Floppy athlete ragdoll running. No chat. Comedy, not violence — but it is hard and funny-frustrating.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player; no chat, no accounts, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Canabalt
kid-safe.description: The one-button endless runner that started a genre. Jump or die.
kid-safe.parent_note: One-button parkour runner. No chat. Fast and intense, with a giant robot in the background chase.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player runner; assessment from game knowledge — not re-verified on the current page.

kid-safe.title: Line Rider
kid-safe.description: Draw the track, then sled it. Part game, part physics toy, part art form.
kid-safe.parent_note: Draw tracks, watch the sledder ride them. No chat. Pure creativity — every drawing on screen is yours.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player sandbox; assessment from game knowledge — not re-verified on the current page.

kid-safe.title: Slope
kid-safe.description: Steer a ball down an endless neon slope at breakneck speed. One wrong twitch and the run is over.
kid-safe.parent_note: Rolling-ball arcade run. No chat in the game. The host site (crazygames) shows heavy ads — use an ad blocker or watch the first session together.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player game; no in-game chat. crazygames.com is ad-heavy by design.

kid-safe.title: Moto X3M
kid-safe.description: Flip a dirt bike over 22 stunt tracks packed with explosives. Land the backflip or eat the ramp.
kid-safe.parent_note: Stunt-bike time trials. No chat. Crash animations are cartoon ragdoll only. Same ad note as Slope: the host site is ad-heavy.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player game; no in-game chat; crash animations are non-graphic cartoon ragdolls. crazygames.com is ad-heavy.

kid-safe.title: Clumsy Bird
kid-safe.description: The open-source Flappy Bird. Tap through the pipes, rage, repeat — and the code is right there to read.
kid-safe.parent_note: A flappy-style clone, one button. No chat, no content concerns.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player; no chat, no accounts, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Astray
kid-safe.description: A procedurally generated 3D maze walked in first person. Open source, quietly unsettling, different every run.
kid-safe.parent_note: A 3D maze explorer. No chat. Calm — no enemies, no timer pressure.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player maze; no chat, no accounts, no user content.

kid-safe.title: HexGL
kid-safe.description: A futuristic anti-gravity racer in WebGL. Open source and still slick more than a decade later.
kid-safe.parent_note: Anti-grav racer. No chat. Fast but clean.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player racer; no chat, no multiplayer features in the browser build.

kid-safe.title: Minecraft Classic
kid-safe.description: The 2009 creative-mode classic, free in the browser. Build with the original 32 blocks, invite friends to your world.
kid-safe.parent_note: The official free browser classic — creative mode, no chat in the browser build, no accounts. Building blocks only.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Official classic.minecraft.net build is single-player creative with no chat or accounts.

kid-safe.title: Dragonsweeper
kid-safe.description: Minesweeper reborn as a monster-slaying roguelike. Every number is a tactical puzzle.
kid-safe.parent_note: Minesweeper meets monster-slaying tactics. No chat. Mild fantasy combat and reading-heavy rules.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player puzzle; no chat, no accounts, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Celeste Classic
kid-safe.description: The original PICO-8 Celeste: brutally precise mountain climbing across 30 levels.
kid-safe.parent_note: A tough-but-fair platformer about climbing a mountain. No chat. Kind story, no content issues — the difficulty is the watch.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player platformer (PICO-8 original); no chat, no accounts; wholesome theme.

kid-safe.title: Cookie Clicker
kid-safe.description: The idle game that defined idle games. Bake cookies. Achieve absurdity.
kid-safe.parent_note: Click and bake cookies, hire grandmas. No chat. Silly and harmless — the grandmas are the joke.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player idle game; no chat, accounts, or user content.

kid-safe.title: A Dark Room
kid-safe.description: Starts as a text game about keeping a fire lit. Becomes something much stranger.
kid-safe.parent_note: A text adventure that starts with a fire. No chat. Slow-burn story with mildly spooky themes — better for older kids.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player text game; no chat; themes are mild survival/spooky, text only.

kid-safe.title: Universal Paperclips
kid-safe.description: An AI that makes paperclips. That's it. That's the game. (It's incredible.)
kid-safe.parent_note: Make paperclips, take over the world. No chat. Reading-heavy strategy.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player incremental; no chat, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Candy Box 2
kid-safe.description: Eat candy. Get a sword. Save the world. The ASCII adventure that keeps surprising you.
kid-safe.parent_note: An ASCII adventure built from candy. No chat. Mild text combat, very tame.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player; text-only, no chat; combat is abstract ASCII.

kid-safe.title: Kittens Game
kid-safe.description: Manage a kitten civilization from mud huts to interstellar travel. Absurdly deep.
kid-safe.parent_note: Run a kitten village. No chat. Deep and slow — a project game, not a quick one.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player idle; no chat, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Trimps
kid-safe.description: Lead tiny creatures through zones of escalating danger. Idle with teeth.
kid-safe.parent_note: An idle battler with cute art. No chat. Combat is abstract numbers.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player idle; no chat; combat is numbers-based with cute art.

kid-safe.title: Antimatter Dimensions
kid-safe.description: Prestige-layered incremental about reaching infinity. Then going past it.
kid-safe.parent_note: Numbers-go-up incremental. No chat. Mathy — satisfying for the right kid.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player incremental; no chat, no user content.

kid-safe.title: Swarm Sim
kid-safe.description: Grow a meat-eating bug swarm from a few larvae to a galaxy-devouring horde. Absurdly deep, fully open source.
kid-safe.parent_note: Raise a bug swarm. No chat. Weird-cute, not scary.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player idle; no chat; bug theme is cartoonish, not graphic.

kid-safe.title: Melvor Idle
kid-safe.description: RuneScape-style skilling as a pure idle game. Chop, fish and fight while you do literally anything else.
kid-safe.parent_note: An idle RPG skill trainer. No chat in solo play. The free tier may prompt for an account — sign up together if it does.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player idle RPG; assessment from game knowledge — free-tier account flow not re-verified.

kid-safe.title: Townscaper
kid-safe.description: Click to build a gorgeous seaside town. No goals, no fail states, just vibes.
kid-safe.parent_note: Click to build a pastel town. No chat, no accounts, zero fail state. The gold standard of calm.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player sandbox; no interaction surface; no fail state by design.

kid-safe.title: Slow Roads
kid-safe.description: Endless procedural driving through generated landscapes. Pure zen.
kid-safe.parent_note: Endless scenic drives. No chat. Hypnotically calm.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player driving sandbox; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: Sandspiel
kid-safe.description: A falling-sand toy with fire, water, plants and acid. No goals, no score — just beautiful chaos.
kid-safe.parent_note: A falling-sand toy. No chat. Mesmerizing and safe.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player sandbox toy; no interaction surface.

kid-safe.title: Chrome Music Lab: Song Maker
kid-safe.description: Google's dead-simple music maker. Paint notes on a grid, press play, share the tune.
kid-safe.parent_note: Chrome Music Lab: paint music with your mouse. No chat. Make noise together.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player creative tool by Google; no chat, no accounts.

kid-safe.title: The Deep Sea
kid-safe.description: Scroll from sunlit waves to the abyss, meeting real deep-sea creatures on the way down. Meditative and factual.
kid-safe.parent_note: Scroll down through the ocean on neal.fun. No chat. Beautiful and calm.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player scroll experience on neal.fun; no chat, accounts, or user content.

kid-safe.title: Nested
kid-safe.description: A universe inside a universe inside a universe, from the Cookie Clicker creator. Zoom in forever.
kid-safe.parent_note: Zoom forever into a tiny universe. No chat. Trippy visuals — skip if your kid is sensitive to motion.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-player universe-zoom toy; no chat; motion may bother motion-sensitive kids.

kid-safe.title: goodbye, doggy
kid-safe.description: Help a family as their ghostly dog. Short, tender, and free.
kid-safe.parent_note: A short wholesome story game about a dog. No chat was found on the page. Sweet — the dog theme lands in a good way.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Assessment from page inspection only — not played end-to-end; flagged verify_live.

kid-safe.title: English Brick Breaker
kid-safe.description: A brick breaker that teaches 222 English words across 8 topics. Pure vanilla JS, no accounts, no downloads — Chromebook-friendly.
kid-safe.parent_note: Brick-breaker that teaches 222 English words. Plain static page, no accounts or chat. Great for early readers.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-author vanilla-JS page (wqnlll.github.io); author documents no accounts/downloads; no chat or user content on the page.

kid-safe.title: Math Challenge
kid-safe.description: Timed arithmetic across 7 levels, from single-digit addition to word problems. Vanilla JS, no accounts.
kid-safe.parent_note: Timed arithmetic drills, no accounts or chat. A solid homework-adjacent warm-up.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Single-author vanilla-JS page (wqnlll.github.io); no accounts, chat, or user content on the page.

kid-safe.title: Dare To Doku
kid-safe.description: A GBA Jam 2026 homebrew: a 'star battle' logic puzzle — deduce where every player hides in grids of 4–10 across 10,000 unique levels. Playable in the browser.
kid-safe.parent_note: A pure logic puzzle (find hidden players in a grid) with a tutorial — no chat, no violence. Flagged verify: it's a new GBA homebrew port, so play the first 10 minutes together.
kid-safe.audit_basis: itch.io browser build of a GBA Jam 2026 homebrew; single-player deduction puzzle, no accounts/chat visible; flagged for co-play since the port is new to this audit.

kid-safe.title: Die in the Dungeon CLASSIC
kid-safe.description: A turn-based, dice-building roguelite — no cards, just dice. Guide a frog warrior through 20 floors of monsters; 4.7 stars from thousands of itch.io ratings.
kid-safe.parent_note: Cute dice-battling roguelite — roll dice to fight cartoon dungeon monsters as a frog warrior. No chat. Flagged verify: play the first 10 minutes together.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Unity HTML5 browser build by Alarts; single-player, no accounts/chat; combat is the whole game but stylized and cute — sits at the older band with the verify flag (per dragonsweeper precedent).

kid-safe.title: Tristram
kid-safe.description: Diablo-homage auto-battler: recruit heroes, send them into the cathedral catacombs, and spend their loot rebuilding Tristram. Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 55.
kid-safe.parent_note: Diablo-flavored auto-battler: your recruited heroes fight pixel monsters while you rebuild the town. No chat. Darker fantasy tone than most curated games — flagged verify.
kid-safe.audit_basis: Ludum Dare 55 HTML5 auto-battler by bippinbits; single-player; heroes auto-fight dungeon monsters in a Diablo-homage aesthetic; no accounts/chat; verify flag for the darker tone.

kid-safe.title: Prerolled
kid-safe.description: A cozy dice-shop roguelite: craft silly dice boxes, match customer stipulations, upgrade your shop — and make rent, or the run ends.
kid-safe.parent_note: Cozy dice-shop sim — sell silly dice boxes, upgrade your shop, pay rent. No chat. The rent timer can feel pressuring; co-play the first run.
kid-safe.audit_basis: itch.io HTML5 shop sim by Red Sauce Games; single-player strategy, no accounts/chat in the game; economy/rent theme flagged for parents, hence the verify flag.
